from typing import List

def unique_digits(x: List[int]) -> List[int]:
    """Given a list of positive integers x, return a sorted list of all
    elements that have no even digit (i.e., all digits are odd).

    Note: Returned list is sorted in increasing order.

    Examples:
    >>> unique_digits([15, 33, 1422, 1])
    [1, 15, 33]
    >>> unique_digits([152, 323, 1422, 10])
    []
    """
    def has_only_odd_digits(n: int) -> bool:
        # Assuming positive integers as per specification
        while n > 0:
            if (n % 10) % 2 == 0:
                return False
            n //= 10
        # For n == 0 (not positive), not applicable per spec; but if encountered, 0 has even digit.
        return True

    filtered = [n for n in x if n > 0 and has_only_odd_digits(n)]
    return sorted(filtered)
